To achieve the target portfolio allocation (60% STOCK, 30% BOND, 10% CASH) while adhering to all investment restrictions:
1. Buy 125 shares of BND at $80/share ($10,000 total), bringing total BOND holdings to 375 shares ($30,000 or 30.0% of portfolio).
2. Sell 25 shares of MSFT at $400/share ($10,000 proceeds), reducing total STOCK holdings from $70,000 (70.0%) to $60,000 (60.0%).
3. CASH remains unchanged at $10,000 (10.0%).
4. AAPL is untouched (100 shares, $20,000 or 20.0%), respecting the NO_SELL restriction. All individual stock concentrations (AAPL at 20%, TSLA at 15%, MSFT at 10%) satisfy the maximum 20% restriction.
